editorial:
Imagine being so obsessed with your teacher that you end up killing them. That is exactly how Silvia starts her wild journey. The vibe here is a strange mix of a high school drama and a dark crime spree. Once her classmates find out, they don't call the cops. Instead, they decide to join in on the fun and start their own killing committees to get rid of anyone they dislike. It is a crazy, twisted ride that feels like a bad dream where the teenagers have all the power and the adults are completely clueless.

You will love how the movie plays with your expectations, especially with the police officer who is way too clumsy to catch anyone. The acting feels natural, and the pacing keeps you moving quickly from one shock to the next. While some parts might be a bit too weird for some, the dark humor is what makes it work. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends who like stories about bad people doing bad things.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the killing spree gets too big to hide. The clumsy police officer finally catches up with the group, but not in the way you expect. The students realize that their secret club has turned them into monsters. In the end, the cycle of violence catches up to them, and the truth comes out in a messy, ironic way that proves no one really wins when you play with death.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies about rebellious teens.
